# `skillset lookup`

> Generated from Skillset's CLI presentation contract. See the [documentation system](../../development/documentation-system.md).

Look up schema, provider facts, and scoped capability fidelity.

## `skillset lookup`

Look up schema, provider facts, and scoped capability fidelity.

### Usage

```text
skillset lookup capability [semantic-id-or-native-alias...] [--compat [claude|codex|cursor...]] [--json]
skillset lookup [subject] [aspect...] [--frontmatter] [--fields] [--field <path>] [--values] [--events] [--compat [claude|codex|cursor...]] [--examples] [--schema] [--json]
```

### Options

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--compat [value...]` | Compare selected providers. Capability fidelity describes the stated semantic scope against pinned evidence; changed or missing registry evidence yields unknown. Implementation changes require regression review. Destination support does not prove runtime activation or effectiveness. |
| `--events` | Show lookup event facts. |
| `--examples` | Show lookup examples. |
| `--field <value>` | Select one lookup field path. |
| `--fields` | Show lookup field facts. |
| `--frontmatter` | Show lookup frontmatter facts. |
| `--json` | Emit exactly one versioned finite JSON result document. |
| `--schema` | Show lookup schema facts. |
| `--values` | Show lookup finite-value facts. |

### Examples

```text
skillset lookup
skillset lookup workspace --field compile.targets --values
skillset lookup hooks --events --compat codex
skillset lookup capability skill-invocation --compat claude,codex
skillset lookup capability developer_instructions --compat codex --json
```

## `skillset lookup features`

List compiler feature capabilities.

### Usage

```text
skillset lookup features [feature-id] [--json]
```

### Options

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | Emit exactly one versioned finite JSON result document. |
